name: Lion
fact: Lions are the most social of all big cats and live together in groups called prides.

name: Elephant
fact: Elephants can communicate using low-frequency sounds that humans cannot hear.

name: Eagle
fact: An eagle's eyesight is up to 8 times stronger than a human's.

name: Snake
fact: Snake use their forked tongue to smell the air and detect prey or predators.

name: Shark
fact: Shark are ancient, diverse predators that have exist for over 450 million years.

name: Turtle
fact: A turtle's shell is actually part of its skeleton, consisting of over 50 bones fused together, including their rib cage and spine.

name: Chameleon
fact: . Beyond camouflage, they change color to regulate body temperature and communicate emotions like fear or aggression.

name: Crocodile
fact: Crocodiles are ancient apex predators that have existed for over 235 million years, outliving the dinosaurs.

name: Frog
fact: Frogs don' drink water. They absorb it through their skin.

name: Whale
fact: Whales are the largest animals on Earth, with some species growing up to 100 feet long.

name: Axolotl
fact: Axolotl is famous for their extreme regeneration, able to regrow organs throughout their lives.

name: Hellbender
fact: Unlike most salamanders, hellbenders can't regrow their limbs or tails if they are lost.

name: Owl
fact: Owls are renowned for their specialized, near-silent flight, allowing them to act as stealthy, nocturnal predators.

name: Raven
fact: Ravens are highly intelligent, playful, and emotionally complex birds that can solve puzzles, mimic human speech, and use gestures to communicate.

name: Parrot
fact: Parrot have an ability to imitate human speech.
